title: Boxing
when: Bag classes since late 2025; competitive training at Saroornagar Indoor Stadium, Hyderabad, since May 2026
summary: Training from six to nine every morning, sparring regularly, and aiming for the senior state championships in November 2027. Even if I do not win, the year of training it takes to get there is worth it on its own.
moment: My first spar. Nervous before the bell, out of breath after it, and told in the same breath that I did well and that there is a long way to go. I keep both. The second one is what I train with every morning.

title: Artwork
summary: Paintings, drawings and sketches, and paper art. Mostly for the walls at home and for people I know.
moment: The appreciation I got for a wall painting of a meditating Hanuman. People still ask about it.

title: Guitar
summary: Self-taught on an acoustic: chords, a few fingerstyle pieces, and whatever friends ask for when one is around.
moment: Borrowing a friend's guitar to learn my favourite song, one chord at a time, to playing it on a guitar of my own.

title: Volleyball
when: Lala Lajpat Rai Hall of Residence, IIT Kharagpur
summary: Represented Lala Lajpat Rai Hall of Residence at the Inter Hall Gymkhana Championship 2021-22.
moment: Late dinners with the team after practice, with the mess keeping our plates aside because they knew we would come.

title: NSS and volunteering
summary: Best volunteer of the gold-winning team at the NSS Annual Camp 2019 and part of the cloth-collection drive. Led the COVID fundraising campaign at GYWS in 2021 and conducted a tree plantation drive in Gopali village in 2022, planting 15 saplings.
moment: Walking up to our NSS unit professor right after we won the gold at the annual camp. His face said more than the medal did.
